Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class MfaAuthorizationManager

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.MfaAuthorizationManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<org.springframework.security.web.access.intercept.RequestAuthorizationContext>
public class MfaAuthorizationManager extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<org.springframework.security.web.access.intercept.RequestAuthorizationContext>
Decides whether an authentication has presented enough factors for the request being served: when the client or the user requires multi-factor authentication, the factors must satisfy the MfaPolicy; otherwise any authentication does. A refusal names the second factors that are missing, so Spring Security can send the user to the page that collects them.
